description:
No 3rd party resumes please 
 
 MUST HAVE: 

 
 -7+ years of SQL Developer experience – Must have experience with SQL Server 2008 R2 – they are already moving to 2012
 -Strong SSIS development experience
 -Strong T-SQL development experience
 -Dynamic SQL development experience
 -Well versed in views, stored procedures, high-level functions
 -Familiar with table variables and CTE (Common table expression)
 -Familiar with Agile environment
 -Someone with a strong work-ethic and self-motivated
 NICE TO HAVE: 
 -SSAS
 -Biz-Talk experience
 -Previous Wells Fargo Experience
 Senior Level experience with SQL Server 2008, 2008R2, or 2012.
 Experienced in designing and developing ETL processes using SSIS.
 Solid foundation in designing data models and developing in T-SQL is required
 



 Needed who worked on "javascript software".
